public static partial class ModEntry
{
    static partial void InitializeItems() => ItemData.InitializeArt();

internal static class ItemData
{
    private static readonly JsonElement Data = Load();
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> ArtAssets = Data.GetProperty("relics").EnumerateArray().Concat(Data.GetProperty("potions").EnumerateArray())
        .Where(row => row.TryGetProperty("art", out _)).SelectMany(row => row.GetProperty("art").EnumerateObject())
        .Select(property => property.Value.GetString()!).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToDictionary(Uri, asset => asset, StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private static bool ArtInitialized;
    internal static void InitializeArt()
    {
        if (ArtInitialized) return;
        // Native UI can inline texture getters. Use virtual paths to registered
        // resources instead. Decode on the main thread before native preloading.
        foreach (var asset in ArtAssets.Values) RegisteredTexture(asset);
        // BigIcon memoizes its resolved path and uses AssetCache instead of
        // asking the virtual path again. Keep that route valid after unloads.
        if (ArtAssets.Count > 0) {
            var method = typeof(AssetCache).GetMethods(System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                .Single(m => m.Name == "GetAsset" && !m.IsGenericMethod && m.GetParameters().Length == 1);
            new Harmony(typeof(ModEntry).FullName + ".item-art").Patch(method,
                prefix: new HarmonyMethod(typeof(ItemData), nameof(CachedArt)));
        }
        ArtInitialized = true;
    }
    private static string Uri(string asset) => "res://" + typeof(ModEntry).Namespace + "/builder-item-art/" + asset[7..];
    private static Texture2D RegisteredTexture(string asset)
    {
        var texture = ModEntry.Texture(asset[7..]);
        var uri = Uri(asset);
        if (texture.ResourcePath != uri) texture.TakeOverPath(uri);
        return texture;
    }
    private static bool CachedArt(string __0, ref Resource __result)
    {
        if (!ArtAssets.TryGetValue(__0, out var asset)) return true;
        __result = RegisteredTexture(asset);
        return false;
    }
    internal static string ArtPath(JsonElement row, string role, string fallback)
    {
        if (!row.TryGetProperty("art", out var art) || !art.TryGetProperty(role, out var path)) return fallback;
        var asset = path.GetString()!;
        RegisteredTexture(asset);
        return Uri(asset);
    }
    private static JsonElement Load()
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(@ITEMS_JSON@);
        return doc.RootElement.Clone();
    }
    internal static JsonElement Row(string group, string id) => Data.GetProperty(group).EnumerateArray()
        .Single(r => r.GetProperty("id").GetString() == id);
    internal static string Rules(JsonElement effects) => string.Join(" NL ", new[] {
        effects.GetProperty("block").GetInt32() is > 0 and var block ? $"Gain {block} Block." : null,
        effects.GetProperty("draw").GetInt32() is > 0 and var draw ? $"Draw {draw} card(s)." : null,
        effects.GetProperty("energy").GetInt32() is > 0 and var energy ? $"Gain {energy} Energy." : null,
        effects.GetProperty("focus").GetInt32() is > 0 and var focus ? $"Gain {focus} Focus. Each Focus grants 1 Block at the end of your turn." : null
    }.Where(s => s != null));
    internal static async Task Apply(PlayerChoiceContext context, Player player, JsonElement effects)
    {
        int Number(string key) => effects.GetProperty(key).GetInt32();
        if (Number("block") > 0) await CreatureCmd.GainBlock(player.Creature, Number("block"), ValueProp.Unpowered, null);
        if (Number("draw") > 0) await CardPileCmd.Draw(context, Number("draw"), player);
        if (Number("energy") > 0) await PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(Number("energy"), player);
        @FOCUS_EFFECT@
    }
}

@RELIC_POOL_TYPE@

public abstract class AuthoredRelic : CustomRelicModel
{
    protected AuthoredRelic() : base(false) { }
    private JsonElement Row => ItemData.Row("relics", GetType().Name[6..]);
    public override RelicRarity Rarity => Enum.Parse<RelicRarity>(Row.GetProperty("rarity").GetString()!);
    public override string PackedIconPath => ItemData.ArtPath(Row, "icon", ModelDb.Relic<BurningBlood>().PackedIconPath);
    protected override string PackedIconOutlinePath => ItemData.ArtPath(Row, "outline", ModelDb.Relic<BurningBlood>().PackedIconPath);
    protected override string BigIconPath => ItemData.ArtPath(Row, "large", ModelDb.Relic<BurningBlood>().PackedIconPath);
    public override List<(string,string)> Localization => [
        ("title", Row.GetProperty("name").GetString()!),
        ("description", (Row.GetProperty("trigger").GetString() == "first-turn"
            ? "At the start of your first turn each combat: " : "At the start of each of your turns: ") + ItemData.Rules(Row.GetProperty("effects"))),
        ("flavor", Row.TryGetProperty("flavor", out var flavor) ? flavor.GetString()! : "")
    ];
    public override bool IsAllowed(IRunState runState) => runState.Players.Any(p => p.Character is Character);
    [SavedProperty] public int LastTriggeredTurn { get; set; } = -1;
    public override Task BeforeCombatStart() { LastTriggeredTurn = -1; return Task.CompletedTask; }
    public override async Task AfterPlayerTurnStart(PlayerChoiceContext context, Player player)
    {
        if (player != Owner || player.PlayerCombatState is not { } combat) return;
        var turn = combat.TurnNumber;
        if (turn == LastTriggeredTurn || (Row.GetProperty("trigger").GetString() == "first-turn" && turn != 1)) return;
        LastTriggeredTurn = turn; // Claim before awaited effects to avoid duplicate trigger application.
        await ItemData.Apply(context, Owner, Row.GetProperty("effects"));
    }
}

@POTION_POOL_TYPE@

public abstract class AuthoredPotion : CustomPotionModel
{
    protected AuthoredPotion() : base(false) { }
    private JsonElement Row => ItemData.Row("potions", GetType().Name[7..]);
    public override PotionRarity Rarity => Enum.Parse<PotionRarity>(Row.GetProperty("rarity").GetString()!);
    public override PotionUsage Usage => PotionUsage.CombatOnly;
    public override TargetType TargetType => TargetType.Self;
    public override string CustomPackedImagePath => ItemData.ArtPath(Row, "icon", ModelDb.Potion<BlockPotion>().ImagePath);
    public override string CustomPackedOutlinePath => ItemData.ArtPath(Row, "outline", ModelDb.Potion<BlockPotion>().OutlinePath ?? ModelDb.Potion<BlockPotion>().ImagePath);
    public override string CustomLargeImagePath => ItemData.ArtPath(Row, "large", ModelDb.Potion<BlockPotion>().ImagePath);
    public override List<(string,string)> Localization => [
        ("title", Row.GetProperty("name").GetString()!), ("description", ItemData.Rules(Row.GetProperty("effects")))
    ];
    protected override async Task OnUse(PlayerChoiceContext context, Creature? target)
    {
        AssertValidForTargetedPotion(target);
        if (!IsValidTarget(target)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid authored potion target.");
        await ItemData.Apply(context, Owner, Row.GetProperty("effects"));
    }
}
